decks.notes: The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also applying pressure. Dauthi Voidwalker and Not Dead After All provide graveyard interaction, while cards like Terminate and Fatal Push offer removal options. The deck also includes cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Raucous Theater for extra power and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption, aggression, and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow you to gain life and control the board while gradually building up your resources. By using Martyr of Sands in combination with cards like Abiding Grace and Solitude, you can quickly gain a large amount of life and protect your creatures. Cards like Field of Ruin and Skyclave Apparition help you control your opponent's board while keeping your life total high. The deck aims to outvalue your opponent by creating a favorable board state and overwhelming them with resilient threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and versatile spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves utilizing Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact to protect key creatures like Scion of Draco and Nishoba Brawler, while also using cards like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board control to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game with various removal spells and counterspells, while also utilizing The One Ring to gain advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes a mix of board wipes, counterspells, and versatile removal options to keep the opposition at bay. Additionally, the inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to control the tempo of the game and disrupt the opponent's plays. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and support the deck's control strategy.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing a wide range of colors and the companion ability of Jegantha, the Wellspring, the deck is able to consistently put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. With powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, along with versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, this deck is focused on quickly closing out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to generate value and disrupt opponents, ultimately setting up a combo win condition. With cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can control the board and generate card advantage. The inclusion of various creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse allows for flexible and powerful plays. Chord of Calling acts as a tutor to find the necessary creatures, while Blood Artist provides a potential win condition. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents through strategic creature choices and synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast Living End, a powerful board wipe and creature resurrection spell. By filling the deck with low mana cost cards like Ardent Plea and Architects of Will, the player can consistently Cascade into Living End to wipe the board and bring back powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Negation and Faerie Macabre to control the opponent's board. Overall, the goal is to control the game until the player can combo off and overwhelm the opponent with a large board presence.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to apply continuous pressure on the opponent, utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Slickshot Show-Off. It also incorporates cards like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart for direct damage, while also utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration for card advantage. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for graveyard recursion and additional spell casting from the graveyard. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek to generate a large number of flying tokens, while also utilizing Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and provide additional value. Control elements like Esper Sentinel and Metallic Rebuke help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, with additional tools like Portable Hole and Pithing Needle to handle threats. The deck aims to control the game through a combination of powerful artifacts and disruption, eventually overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of thopters and powerful equipment.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's hand and board while quickly applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Liliana of the Veil to control the game early on, while also taking advantage of the aggressive capabilities of cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck's powerful land package, including Urza's Saga and Mishra's Factory, provides additional threats and value throughout the game. Overall, this Mono Black Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a balance of disruption and aggression.

The deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while applying pressure with powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. It also utilizes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Not Dead After All to disrupt graveyard strategies. The mana base is designed to support both Rakdos colors and fetch lands are used to thin the deck and fix mana. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game through disruption while applying a fast clock to win before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also includes cards like Bitter Reunion and Bitter Triumph to fuel its graveyard and dominate the board. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to combo off quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The use of lands like Dwarven Mine and Commercial District helps to ensure a consistent mana base for the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures using Chord of Calling to create a toolbox of options for different situations. The key strategy is to efficiently tutor for the right creature at the right time to deal with threats or advance your game plan. By utilizing mana dorks like Ignoble Hierarch and Wall of Roots, the deck aims to ramp into powerful combos involving Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Scavenging Ooze and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide utility and resilience against opposing strategies.

The main concept of this UR Aggro Modern deck is to focus on low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck aims to use cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to filter through the deck and find the needed cards, while also utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage quickly. The deck's strategy is to be fast-paced and aggressive, using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to push through the opponent's defenses and secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck revolves around resource denial and removal, using cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Sheoldred's Edict to control the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth allows for generating extra mana to power out threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also utilizes Demolition Field and March of Wretched Sorrow to further punish opposing decks reliant on lands or creatures, creating a strong control strategy to dominate the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early game plays with cards like Thoughtseize, Ragavan, and Grief to disrupt and pressure the opponent. It also utilizes powerful threats like Kroxa, Sheoldred, and Orcish Bowmasters to maintain pressure throughout the game. The deck has a mix of disruption, removal, and threats to quickly close out games before opponents have a chance to stabilize. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also providing the necessary colors for its powerful spells.
